title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
text: Performing different forms thematic susceptibility mapping machine learning, based Filho et al. (2024).

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
code: thematic_susceptibility_mapping(   x,   y,   target_col,   p,   drop_cols,   k_folds,   method,   mtry,   ntree,   cost,   preProcess,   n_class,   predict,   path_metrics,   path_var_imp,   path_prediction )

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
text: x Input stack raster files. y Input samples (vector files) terra sf package R. target_col Numeric. Target field occurrence. p Numeric. Regarding number samples representing non-occurrence events, suggested, order balance sample set, use sample size equal number event occurrences. drop_cols allows remove information used susceptibility modeling. k_folds Numeric. Number folds number resampling iterations, using cross-validation method. method Random Forest "rf" Support Vector Machine "svm" mtry Numeric. Randomly selected predictors ntree Numeric. Decision tree number cost Numeric. Constraint violation cost, 'C' regularization parameter. preProcess Estimates required parameters operation (e.g., 'nzv' near-zero variance filtering, c('center', 'scale') normalization). details available pre-processing methods, see caret package R documentation. n_class Numeric. positive class value confusion matrix (e.g., 0 non-occurrence 1 occurrence). predict Numeric. Predicted thematic susceptibility status, 1 indicates non-occurrence 2 indicates occurrence. path_metrics Character. Path save machine learning model metrics tabular format. path_var_imp Character. Path save machine learning model variable importance tabular format. path_prediction Character. Path save susceptibility prediction raster/matrix format.
